config.goop.GoopCap.description: The Maximum Amount of Goop Puddles that can exist at a time.
config.goop.RainCleaning.description: Whether Goop Puddles should be washed away by rain.
config.goop.Permanent.description: Whether Goop Puddles should never expire. (they will still be removed once the cap is reached)
config.goop.PuddleRotation.description: Whether Puddles should be randomly rotated.
config.goop.Fancy.description: More Elaborate Goop Rendering; Puddles deform on walls and ceilings and makes puddles dynamic.
config.goop.CensorMature.description: Whether Goop Emitters marked as mature should be replaced using a censor color.
config.goop.Debug.description: [WARNING; MAY LAG A LOT] adds debug particles to goop puddles.
